title: Fix broken links in the install guide
story: As a new user I want working links in the install guide so that I can finish the setup
acceptance_criteria: All 14 links return 200; link check passes in CI

title: Document the retry behaviour of the SDK
story: As an integrator I want the retry rules documented so that I can plan for outages
acceptance_criteria: Page lists attempts and back-off; example code runs; reviewed by an SDK maintainer

title: Add a timeout option to the CLI export
story: As an operator I want a timeout for exports so that a stuck export does not block the pipeline
acceptance_criteria: --timeout flag with default 60 s; exit code 3 on timeout; unit test and help text

title: Rename the config key api_url to base_url
story: As a developer I want one consistent key name so that the docs and the code agree

title: Add a changelog page to the docs site
story: As a customer I want a changelog so that I can see what changed per release
acceptance_criteria: Page lists the last 5 releases; generated from the release notes; linked in the footer

title: Migrate code samples to the new client class
story: As an integrator I want samples on the new client so that I do not copy deprecated code
acceptance_criteria: All samples in the quick start use Client; samples run in CI

title: Show the API version in the CLI help
story: As an operator I want the API version in --help so that I know what the CLI targets
acceptance_criteria: --help prints the version; test covers the output

title: Explain the permission model in the docs
story: As an admin I want the permission model explained so that I grant the right roles

title: Rewrite the whole authentication guide
story: As a developer I want a complete authentication guide so that I can integrate sign-in
acceptance_criteria: Covers token, refresh and revoke flows; each flow has a runnable sample

title: Add an examples folder with three starter projects
story: As a new user I want starter projects so that I can begin quickly
acceptance_criteria: Three folders build with one command; README per project

title: Remove the legacy v1 endpoints from the reference
story: As a maintainer I want v1 gone from the reference so that nobody starts on it

title: Add a troubleshooting section for proxy errors
story: As a support engineer I want a proxy troubleshooting section so that I can answer tickets faster
acceptance_criteria: Lists the 4 most common errors with cause and fix; reviewed by support
